lines: Cold stone, warm now. I watched it wake.
rook.bend.ready.1.speaker: rook

lines: The bear sent you. Big paws. Slow. Like you.
rook.bend.ready.2.speaker: rook

lines: Paper says river. River says west. Follow the road.
rook.road.1.speaker: rook

lines: Road west, to the loud water. I fly ahead.
rook.road.2.speaker: rook

lines: Stones in the water. Hop them to the west bank.
rook.stones.1.speaker: rook

lines: Hop. Hop. Hop. Do not stop to count fish.
rook.stones.2.speaker: rook

lines: A mark on the Ford stone. Cut, not scratched.
Read it. Then the footpath north. Smoke there.
rook.smoke.1.speaker: rook

lines: Mark first. Smoke after. I keep away from fire.
rook.smoke.2.speaker: rook

lines: Road west. Walk till the ground gets wet.
rook.road.active.speaker: rook

lines: The stones. Hop them. West bank, then me.
rook.stones.active.speaker: rook

lines: The mark on the Ford stone. Then north, to smoke.
rook.smoke.active.speaker: rook

lines: Loud water. You found it. Wet feet? Not yet.
rook.road.ready.speaker: rook

lines: Stones cross it. I counted them twice. Next.
rook.road.ready2.speaker: rook

lines: Across. Boots wet. I said so. I always say so.
rook.stones.ready.speaker: rook

lines: Now look at the stone here. Cold. Very cold.
rook.stones.ready2.speaker: rook

lines: Smoke means fire. Fire means hands. Many hands.
rook.smoke.ready.speaker: rook

lines: People. Go see. I stay. People throw stones.
rook.smoke.ready2.speaker: rook

lines: Ha. The fell-bird walks.
rook.meet.1.speaker: rook

lines: ...You talk too.
rook.meet.2.speaker: you

lines: Talk. Count. Keep. Crows do all three.
rook.meet.3.speaker: rook

lines: Rook, the others call me.
rook.meet.4.speaker: rook

lines: Your stone blinks now. Like the far one.
rook.meet.5.speaker: rook

lines: It's passing the call along. Toward home.
rook.meet.6.speaker: you

lines: The loud hill? The loud hill never listens.
rook.meet.7.speaker: rook

lines: Watch it blink. Count. Then see the knot.
rook.meet.8.speaker: rook

lines: Nine blinks. Then quiet. Then me.
rook.meet.9.speaker: rook

lines: Slow walker. The stone will wait.
rook.later.speaker: rook

lines: Count the blinks. Then the knot. Then me.
rook.call.active.speaker: rook

lines: Counted? Nine blinks, then quiet. Again.
rook.call.ready.1.speaker: rook

lines: That knot. A lamp-trimmer tied it.
rook.call.ready.2.speaker: you

lines: Long ago. Nobody untied it. I tried.
rook.call.ready.3.speaker: rook

lines: Here. Paper. River on it. Not shiny.
rook.call.ready.4.speaker: rook

lines: West is the river. The next stone is cold.
rook.call.ready.5.speaker: rook

lines: I will be there first. Wings.
rook.call.ready.6.speaker: rook

lines: River. West. Do not drown, fell-bird.
rook.repeat.speaker: rook

lines: Slow walker. Wet boots?
rook.ford.1.speaker: rook

lines: The waystone here is dead. Its glass is gone.
rook.ford.2.speaker: you

lines: Gone? No. Kept. Kept is different.
rook.ford.3.speaker: rook

lines: You took it.
rook.ford.4.speaker: you

lines: It fell. I found it. Then it was mine.
rook.ford.5.speaker: rook

lines: Old house by the crossing. Inside, on the floor.
rook.ford.6.speaker: rook

lines: I have other shinies. Many.
rook.ford.7.speaker: rook

lines: Old house by the crossing. Bring the glass to the stone.
rook.ford.8.speaker: rook

lines: Old house by the crossing. Look on the floor.
rook.mirror.active.speaker: rook

lines: Blink, blink. Bend, Ford, the far one. Three.
rook.mirror.done.1.speaker: rook

lines: My glass, your stone. A loan. I keep count.
rook.mirror.done.2.speaker: rook

lines: North, smoke. Fires. People, maybe. Go look.
rook.ford.repeat.speaker: rook

lines: Wet boots, full pack. Still a slow walker.
rook.ford.repeat2.speaker: rook
